title: FL2EngineConfigContract
description: Strongly-typed JSON schema for Fast-LZMA2 engine configuration and runtime parameter boundaries.

dictionary_size.description: LZMA2 dictionary size in bytes (64KB to 64MB)

max_memory_budget_bytes.description: Maximum memory ceiling in bytes (64MB to 2GB, default 512MB)

enable_hybrid_neon_l1.description: Whether to auto-route Level 1 to handwritten ARM64 NEON fast encoder

enable_zero_block_bypass.description: Whether to enable vectorized zero-block detection and direct encoding
